risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and transparent, with detailed year-over-year financial figures, quantified cybersecurity impacts, insurance recoveries, and currency effects. Management reports improved 2024 results but acknowledges material forward-looking risks from macroeconomic weakness, commercial office pressures, supply-chain constraints, tariffs, freight costs, and geopolitical conditions. Forward-looking statements rely on moderate hedging and provide limited quantified sensitivity for these risks.
